title: section
description: The globally agreeing assignment over a sheaf's base: the settled value at each cell into which the local settlements glue. It is the content of the descent's fixed point, read as one coherent whole once disagreement is resolved.

assignment.description: the settled value at each cell of the base: the fixed-point valuation read cell by cell

globallyAgrees.description: the local settlements agree on overlaps, so the per-cell assignment forms one coherent whole over the base

glues.description: a global section exists exactly when the gluing succeeds with no obstruction (H^1 = 0)
